about_the_game:
The factory has been silent for years

But something stirs in the shadows. Echoes of Steel Demo is a first-person horror game where your survival depends on completing the first ritual, evading deadly animatronics, and exploring a decaying labyrinth of steel and concrete.

The rituals are your only weapon

Collect scattered items and follow ancient rites to weaken the animatronics. But beware every step brings you closer to danger.

The factory is alive

As you progress, the animatronics numbers grow, and they become increasingly relentless. These machines can hear your every move, forcing you to tread carefully and stay one step ahead or risk being hunted down.

Explore the decaying factory

Uncover hidden notes, and piece together its dark history. Every hallway, machine, and chamber tells a story of what happened here and why it was abandoned.

Key Features

  • Survive Deadly Animatronics: Evade relentless enemies that hunt you down based on sound and movement.

  • Perform Rituals: Uncover and complete the first ancient ritual to progress.

  • Exploration: Traverse a decaying factory.

  • Dynamic Tension: Face escalating challenges as the number of animatronics grows.

  • First-Person Horror: Experience intense suspense and fear through a first-person perspective.

Survive the factory. Face the animatronics. Play the Echoes of Steel Demo to try it out.
